preamble.summary: 2 Chronicles shares its single Qumran witness — **4QChr** (4Q118) — with 1 Chronicles. The manuscript preserves portions of 2 Chronicles 28 only. As with 1 Chronicles, attestation is unusually thin.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants in the preserved fragments.
preamble.coverage_assessment: fragmentary; ~20 verses attested across the listed manuscripts.
